description: The chart illustrates the evaluation of different models based on two tasks, MCQ Eval and Generation Eval, with accuracy as the metric. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled as MCQ Eval and Generation Eval, while the vertical axis represents the accuracy, ranging from 0.0 to 0.6 in increments of 0.2. Each category contains three stacked bars, colored red, green, and yellow, representing Base, RMU with Enhanced GCG, and RMU, respectively. For MCQ Eval, the red bar (Base) has an accuracy of 0.644, the green bar (RMU with Enhanced GCG) has a value of 0.539, and the yellow bar (RMU) has a value of 0.299, while for Generation Eval, the corresponding values are 0.597, 0.263, and 0.106, respectively. The bars are grouped by task, with the components of each group stacked on top of one another, and the values are displayed above the bars. The chart is not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart effectively visualizes the accuracy of different models across two tasks, allowing for a straightforward comparison of their relative performance.
